text:
I believe the authors are wildly overstating the conclusions in their abstract.

Did they test modifying the weights of a non-public model?

Did they test modifying the weights of a non-LLM (and non-public) model?

If not, we can only conclude that GPT-6 Astra is good at reading and writing weights of Qwen (a public LLM), not just any neutral network.
